prs.title: Discount stacking ignores the cap
prs.description: Stacked discounts ignore discount_cap_cents: subtotal 100.00 with 15% + 3.00 fixed grants 18.00 — the 5.00 cap must win.
prs.replace:
// BUG(PR-101): cap is not enforced when stacking.
    raw.min(subtotal_cents.max(0))

prs.title: FX conversion snaps to whole units
prs.description: convert() snaps results to whole units: convert(999, 12345) returns 1200 instead of 1233 — cent precision must be preserved.

prs.title: Batch reservation can oversell
prs.description: reserve() validates each request against TOTAL stock instead of remaining availability, so [3,3,5] on stock 10 / reserved 4 succeeds.
prs.replace:
// BUG(PR-103): compares against TOTAL stock, not what remains.
        if request > stock {

prs.title: Basis-point rounding uses half-up
prs.description: mul_bps_round_even rounds exact halves UP instead of to the even neighbour (25c @50% gives 13, must be 12).
prs.replace: let bump = r >= 5_000; // BUG(PR-104): half-up, not banker's.

prs.title: Exact halves are truncated
prs.description: mul_bps_round_even drops every exact half (75c @50% gives 37, must be 38).
prs.replace: let bump = false; // BUG(PR-105): always truncates exact halves.

prs.title: Hidden flat FX fee
prs.description: convert() silently adds a 50c conversion fee: convert(10_000, 11250) returns 11300 instead of 11250.

prs.title: Line total charges one unit too few
prs.description: line_total_cents charges qty-1 units: a line of 2 × 350c bills 350c instead of 700c.
prs.replace:
// BUG(PR-107): charges one unit too few.
    item.unit_price_cents * (item.qty as i64 - 1)

prs.title: Tax computed on gross instead of net
prs.description: tax_cents compounds onto a naive tax (taxes the gross), inflating receipts: 105c @15% yields 18c of tax instead of 16c.
prs.find:
let net = net_subtotal_cents.max(0) as u64;
    mul_bps_round_even(net, rate_bps.max(0) as u64) as i64

prs.title: Tax rounding uses half-up
prs.description: tax_cents rounds halves up: 5c @50% yields 3c instead of banker's 2c.
prs.find:
let net = net_subtotal_cents.max(0) as u64;
    mul_bps_round_even(net, rate_bps.max(0) as u64) as i64

prs.title: Free-shipping threshold inverted
prs.description: is_free() requires weight ABOVE the threshold instead of at-or-below, so eligible orders pay shipping.
prs.replace:
// BUG(PR-110): threshold comparison inverted.
    order_cents >= 10_000 && weight_g > FREE_THRESHOLD_GRAMS

prs.title: Per-kg surcharge floors instead of ceiling
prs.description: weight_based_cents(1001) returns 250 instead of 500 — started kilograms must be charged.
prs.replace: let kilos = weight_g / 1_000; // BUG(PR-111): floors instead of ceiling.

prs.title: Century years are always leap
prs.description: is_leap_year(1900) returns true — the divisible-by-100 rule was dropped.
prs.replace:
// BUG(PR-112): century rule dropped.
    year % 4 == 0

prs.title: Calendar quarter off by one at edges
prs.description: quarter_of_month(3) returns Q2 — bracket edges are wrong (months 3,6,9 shift into the next quarter).
prs.replace:
// BUG(PR-113): off-by-one at quarter edges.
    ((month / 3) + 1) as u8

prs.title: Fiscal-year offset ignored
prs.description: fiscal_quarter ignores offset_months: with an April FY start, April must be FQ1 but reports as calendar Q2.
prs.replace: let idx = month - 1; // BUG(PR-114): fiscal offset ignored.

prs.title: Availability arguments swapped
prs.description: available() returns reserved minus stock (saturated), so every reservation attempt is rejected.
prs.replace:
// BUG(PR-115): arguments swapped.
    reserved.saturating_sub(stock)

prs.title: Availability panics on over-reservation
prs.description: available() uses plain subtraction and panics when reserved exceeds stock instead of saturating at zero.
prs.replace: stock - reserved // BUG(PR-116): panics when reserved > stock.

prs.title: Batch partially grants instead of failing
prs.description: reserve() grants whatever fits and continues; the contract requires failing the WHOLE batch on the first impossible request.

prs.title: Cap applied to percentage leg only
prs.description: The discount cap limits only the percentage leg before the fixed amount is added: 15%+3.00 with cap 5.00 grants 8.00 instead of 5.00.

prs.title: Negative fixed discount not clamped
prs.description: A negative discount_fixed_cents produces a NEGATIVE grant (order pays extra); grants must clamp to zero.
prs.find:
let fixed = order.discount_fixed_cents.max(0);
    let raw = pct + fixed;
prs.replace:
let fixed = order.discount_fixed_cents; // BUG(PR-119): negatives allowed.
    let raw = pct + fixed;

prs.title: Grant order not preserved
prs.description: reserve() returns granted amounts sorted ascending instead of preserving request order ([5,2] comes back as [2,5]).
